info.name: Update Data App labels for access control

params.name: id
params.description: Data App ID

items.docs: Replaces all labels assigned to a Data App. Labels drive EARS (Entitlement and Access Rights Service) access control policies — use them to control which users and teams can see and interact with a Data App. Pass an empty array to clear all labels.
